messages:
rebecca (recruiter): quick alert — after running the overnight dedupe/merge job some interviewers no longer show the 'trained' badge and their eval-form links are blank when I open the panel view. blocking interviews tomorrow. :grimacing:

maria (people-ops): oh no. any job id or list of affected candidates?

rebecca (recruiter): job `dedupe-2026-03-23-02`. affected: C-4410, C-4411, C-4413. all came from the referral flow.

kevin (eng): that dedupe job version had a change where we normalize panel metadata. looks like it overwrote `panel_meta` with an empty array for some merges. can you paste the webhook payload if available?

rebecca (recruiter): payload snippet (sanitized): {"job":"dedupe-2026-03-23-02","master":"C-4410","removed":["C-4411","C-4413"],"panels":[]}

oliver (trainer): similar to the import bug we saw last quarter. short-term: run `recalc-trainer-tags` for each candidate to restore the pointer. UI path: Candidate > Actions > Recompute Training Status.

maria (people-ops): can eng run a bulk backfill? we have ~8 interviewers impacted across those panels.

kevin (eng): yes i can run a targeted backfill for those ids and add a defensive copy so merges don't null out `panel_meta`. i'll pause the dedupe schedule until fix is deployed.

recruiting-bot: event dedupe-2026-03-23-02 processed at 2026-03-23T02:14:10Z, affected_count=3, handler=dedupe-service-v1

kevin (eng): backfill complete for C-4410,C-4411,C-4413 — labels and eval links restored. opening PR with validation and an alert when `panels` is empty: https://github.com/redwood/ats/pull/4890 (draft).

maria (people-ops): thanks. pausing schedule now. i'll also send a note to hiring managers and ask interviewers to re-open candidate pages if they hit missing forms.

rebecca (recruiter): verified on my end — forms visible again. please add a short runbook step: "check for empty panels after merges and run recalc if needed".

kevin (eng): will add runbook and a unit test. marking REC-4419 as incident and scheduling a 15m postmortem tomorrow.

maria (people-ops): added to calendar. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
